name: presenter-garage
description: A suite of utilities for ProPresenter 7 files. Runs entirely in your browser.

scripts.dev: npm run protos && npm run dev -w @presenter-garage/web --
scripts.build: npm run protos && npm run build -w @presenter-garage/web
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run build -w @presenter-garage/desktop
scripts.mcp:build: npm run protos && npm run build -w presenter-garage-mcp
scripts.mcp:pack: npm run mcp:build && npm run pack:mcpb -w presenter-garage-mcp
scripts.check: npm run protos && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run mcp:pack && npm run build -w @presenter-garage/cli
scripts.cli:build: npm run protos && npm run build -w @presenter-garage/cli
